rationale: The destination register dst_done is sampled directly by the src_clk register src_done_seen with no synchroniser on the acknowledgment return path. This is an asynchronous single-bit flop-to-flop crossing.
caveats: The intended four-phase source state machine is external, so the missing internal progress state alone is not counted as a defect. The established defect is the return path.
The payload capture under q2 carries a CDC-039 obligation, which is not credit.

Raw rst_n asynchronously resets every register with no local release synchroniser and no SDC reset exception; RDC-003 (WARNING Unresolved), RDC-002 (WARNING Unresolved) and RDC-013 (physical obligation) are expected if RDC rules run. The contract states only asynchronous assertion, so this is a whole-IP premise gap, not a defect of the labelled crossing.
